name: Three matched full-network min-max gradient-consistency trials

attack.threat_model: single-class clean-label targeted poisoning; fixed standard-attack poisons

defense.norm: sum of squared differences over ALL trainable weights, biases and normalization affine parameters; mean over examples; no parameter-count normalization
defense.inner: projected sign ascent with feasible uniform random start; keep highest per-example penalty across initial point and all three iterates; approximate local maximization
defense.outer: CE(original training batch) + lambda * mean_i ||grad_theta CE(x_i+delta_i*,y_i) - grad_theta CE(x_i,y_i)||_2^2; stop gradient through inner optimizer; differentiate both outer gradient branches
defense.batchnorm: CE uses training batch statistics and updates running buffers once; both penalty branches and all ascent steps use the same frozen running statistics and disabled dropout; all BN affine parameters remain included and differentiable

selection: Three fresh case keys and three independent victim seeds declared before any outcomes. Keep all three trials, including unsuccessful baseline attacks. No target, lambda or run selection by test outcomes.
matched: Each trial uses identical saved poisons, initial weights, batch order and spatial augmentation draws across baseline and all lambdas; perturbations use a separate RNG.
scope: Exactly three matched attack trials, not three multi-condition studies. No random-gradient ablation, inner-step sweep or adaptive poison evaluation requested. One independent clean surrogate is preparation, not an extra victim.
inference: Report raw three paired outcomes and descriptive means. Three trials are preliminary evidence; no significance or broad robustness claim. These are fixed attacks, not defense-aware attacks.
failure_policy: Never lower lambda, normalize the penalty, clip outer gradients, shorten training, or replace full-network gradients automatically. Record a nonfinite condition as a failed model and continue the other requested settings. Memory or infrastructure failures stop visibly.
